    CYBERTITANS PULSE SERIES: Visual eSports revolution

    What we did

    The esports sector is massive. Standing out requires excellent Web3 Marketing. LitLab Games challenged us to present the new season of their game CyberTitans—a global tournament called Pulse Series.

    The competition was huge, with incredible prizes for players. As shown in our gallery, we announced rewards up to $300,000. The project needed a visual identity that conveyed pure adrenaline.

    We took full creative direction—delivering the logo, website, bold designs, and high-impact videos. We achieved over 1.4 million real organic views.

    Our digital marketing agency built the entire visual engine. Explore our work step-by-step below.

    Web3 Marketing Strategy: Created Assets

    We broke classic design rules to craft a dynamic visual package around four key deliverables:

    1. Competitive Logotype Design

    A major tournament needs a strong emblem. We created the official logo for the Pulse Series—using sharp geometric forms.

    We applied bright turquoise over dark backgrounds for high contrast, aggression, and presence—forming the aesthetic foundation of our Web3 Marketing.

    2. Game UX/UI Design

    Adrenaline must be felt in-match, so we adapted the game's interface (UX/UI).

    As the visuals show, we highlighted the massive rewards—announcing a $300,000 prize pool and a $5,000 top prize. We presented the game board in an isometric format. The web design pushed players to compete immediately.

    3. Videos, Motion, and Images (Social)

    Social content must be explosive. We delivered dozens of assets for their channels.

    Our thumbnails announced key dates from November through February. We created videos to confirm the tournament's "1000 Winners." We also integrated 3D characters breaking the frame. This material kept the community engaged daily.

    4. Manifesto and Update Video (VFX)

    A tournament of this scale needs a standout presentation—so we edited a direct, human manifesto video.

    We showed the team explaining the season and added high-grade VFX, careful lighting, and color. The video reached thousands of views within hours.

    The Impact of a Strong Visual Ecosystem

    This event was a total win for LitLab Games. Mobilizing thousands of players proves the power of Web3 Marketing. A strong visual identity always multiplies real revenue.
